name: Conditional Email Routing For Contact Form 7
author: Raihan

sections.description:
Routes email to different recipients based on form field values in Contact Form 7. Flexible and powerful conditional email routing for your WordPress forms.

👉 Demo Link: Live Preview

CF7 Conditional Email Routing is a powerful add-on for the Contact Form 7 plugin. It allows you to dynamically route form submissions to different email addresses based on user input. This feature is ideal for businesses and organizations that need to send submissions to specific departments, teams, or individuals based on form field values.

Features:
* Create conditions to route emails dynamically.
* Add multiple conditions for different form fields.
* Easy-to-use interface integrated directly into the Contact Form 7 editor.
* Supports complex field types, including checkboxes and dropdowns.
* Fully customizable and lightweight.

This plugin requires Contact Form 7 to be installed and active.

Example Use Cases

  • Send support tickets to specific departments based on user selection.
  • Route inquiries to regional offices based on location.
  • Notify sales teams based on product category selection.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Contact Form 7 plugin if not already installed.
  2. Upload the cercf7-conditional-email-routing folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to your Contact Form 7 form editor, and you’ll find a new “Conditional Email Routing” tab.
  5. Add your email routing conditions and save the form.
sections.faq:
Do I need Contact Form 7 installed for this plugin to work?

Yes, Contact Form 7 is required for this plugin to function.

Can I route emails to multiple recipients?

Yes, you can define multiple conditions and route emails to multiple recipients based on form field values.

Does this plugin work with custom fields in Contact Form 7?

Yes, the plugin supports custom fields created within the Contact Form 7 editor.

Is the plugin compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

The plugin is tested with the latest version of WordPress. Please ensure your site is updated for the best compatibility.
